title: Travel: John Lennon – New York to Cairo | 1979
content:
John Lennon, Yoko Ono, and Sean Lennon flew from New York to Cairo on 21 January 1979.

They stopped briefly in Geneva before flying on to Egypt. The holiday was a brief one, and they returned to the USA on 24 January.

Page last updated: 12 May 2026

Also on this day...

  • 1975: Recording: Spirits Of Ancient Egypt by Wings
  • 1973: Mixing: Get On The Right Thing by Wings
  • 1972: FBI opens national security investigation into John Lennon
  • 1971: Interview: John Lennon and Yoko Ono for Red Mole
  • 1971: Recording: Little Woman Love by Wings; Another Day by Paul McCartney
  • 1970: John Lennon’s Bag One exhibition opens in Detroit
  • 1969: Get Back/Let It Be sessions: day 12
  • 1969: Ringo Starr is interviewed for the BBC’s Scene And Heard
  • 1966: George Harrison marries Pattie Boyd
  • 1963: Radio: The Friday Spectacular
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Casbah Coffee Club, Liverpool
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Aintree Institute, Liverpool
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Lathom Hall, Liverpool
